findings.title: Consider type-safe approach for the debug marker
findings.description: The `__source = 'localStorage'` marker is added for debugging but `Product` doesn't include this field. The `as Product` cast on line 142 suppresses the type error, which could lead to unexpected behavior if this property is accessed elsewhere.
suggested_fixes: Option 1: Use an intersection type for the debug marker
Option 2: Remove the marker after logging (if not needed in state)
Option 3: Keep the current approach but document the limitation
